name: DLT-18 laser rifle
description: The DLT-18 laser rifle, also known as the DLT-18 heavy blaster rifle, was a model of heavy blaster rifle manufactured by BlasTech Industries. The human bounty hunter Dengar carried a DTL-18 during the Clone Wars. A rugged variation of the DLT-18 was used by the rebel leader Steela Gerrera as a sniper rifle. Steela’s sniper rifle was modified with a scope and a thinner barrel. The bounty hunter Onca carried a DLT-18. Several members of Hondo Ohnaka’s pirate gang and former governor Ryder Azadi used a similar rugged rifle.
